rom: ZX Spectrum 128, ROM 0 (the 128 editor ROM, © 1986 Sinclair Research Ltd)
why: load_boxes ($8AFC-$8B2F) unpacks area 14's grid of blocks from bank 7, and the packed data runs past $FFFF into the ROM paged in at $0000, ROM 0 while the game runs: the $FF at $FFFF takes its count, 243, and its block, $01, from $0000 and $0001, from row 25 column 36, and the 169 bytes from $0002 are one block each, row 29 column 23 to the grid's end. load_area then lays some of the area's own blocks over the left of rows 26 to 31. The +2's ROM 0 differs from these bytes at $009B and $00A0, two of those blocks.
